integration: Base item display with product-defined public int type. No EquipPartType, inventory, mail or reward service dependency.
Use UIItemSlot/VMItemSlot. Original eight binding indices are preserved: Back, Icon, Text, Locked, Amount, Select, Arrow, Edge. IconVisible is appended at index 8.

Icon is a string asset path resolved by existing SyncSprite/UILoader. IconVisible expresses host visibility intent, not loading completion. Mail does not load Sprite or maintain image callbacks. Shared loader cancellation and out-of-order completion need separate validation.
Text is a host-formatted quantity or label. type is an unbound integer property whose meaning belongs to the product.

Assets/Data/Widgets/Common/Micros/ItemSlot/ItemSlot.prefab retains the SV item appearance. Its Lock/Mask/Arrow controls reuse the legacy slot. The old Arrow controller is missing from the source project; the new Arrow is static and has no broken Animator reference.

Existing Widgets/Common/Micros/ItemSlot.prefab keeps its old art and GUID. Upgrade its icon Metadata to SyncSprite and append IconVisible binding to Icon; preserve its TMP text binding. See bindings.json. Do not overwrite unrelated old pages.
Restore native materials/meta first, preserving GUIDs. Included external dependencies are only the required Common fonts and shared UI textures. No Reward or Mail assets are required.

Browser preview retains default item artwork. Radial Mask fill is native-only and previewHidden; three additional controls are serialized in the native prefab. Dynamic behavior must be checked in Unity.
